source_id.description: The UUID of the database instance whose change data you want to store

store_id.description: The UUID of the database instance that will store the change data

auth_api_key_name.description: Any word character (letter, number, underscore) string representing the API key used to create the new authorization

expires_in.description: How long in seconds before the token expires

time_to_live.description: Set expiration in seconds. No expiration if not set.

local_db_id.description: The Heroku Postgres database that’s accepting the connection.

name.description: The name of connection between the remote and local databases.

remote_db_name.description: The data store that is being connected to a Heroku Postgres database.
